# Summary

I am a computer scientist working in Research Software Engineering (RSE). I am currently Group Lead for RSE at the Gesellschaft für Informatik (GI), where I hold the scientific direction of the Special Interest Group on Research Software Engineering, direct the national RSE master's curriculum project and lead the GI RSE Award for outstanding research software.

Before that I was a Research Software Engineer at GESIS -- Leibniz Institute for the Social Sciences, where I was development lead of the KODAQS Toolbox, an open science platform for reusable code and reproducible tutorials, and worked on data quality standards and automated reproducibility checks.

Earlier I was a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Göttingen (social media deliberation, human-in-the-loop experiments with Reddit and Twitter, NLP with transformer models) and at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin (machine learning for the detection of creativity in text). I did my doctorate in computer science at the University of Potsdam, where I built a framework for inquiry-based learning, algorithms for group formation, a semantic competency database and an evaluation methodology for learning technologies.
